scope: Latest complete SEEN012_V1 double-perturbation benchmark; older P0/P1/P2 experiment not replaced
preserved: Existing cells, axes, control partitions, queries, singleton masks, no validation refit, arity-balanced joint loss, single/double shared head and pair-only calibration/tensor kernels. Each fold freezes its original selected lambda_pair, lambda_int and pair_intercept.
updated: 12 public priors; half uniform plus half positive response-kernel alignment; full output responses; alpha in [0.01,0.1,1]. No rank512 truncation.
alignment: Fit-only unique component transforms. Lift each view to original condition kernel using frozen double-head coefficients; compare positive off-diagonal centered alignment against unit training residual Gram after weighted arity-intercept removal and exclusion of all bank target genes from alignment output axis. Fuse NODE kernels then apply unchanged double kernel, preserving tensor cross-view terms.
selection: Seen0 validation only: maximize target-macro mean cosine/L2 PDS, ties by smaller MSE then smaller alpha; a pool with one query has undefined PDS; if all pools undefined use MSE. Alpha frozen across all three arms. Existing double benchmark restriction of no validation refit retained.
prediction: Analytic joint kernel ridge; unpenalized arity/pair intercepts, arity-balanced loss; full response; nonnegative expression projection.
primary_comparison: Same-query old-vs-new paired nMSE; query-context then pair then fold aggregation. Descriptive split SD; paired target-cluster bootstrap 95% intervals and Holm-adjusted paired permutation p over 12 dataset-arm comparisons.
baseline_note: Other models and original three-prior baselines preserved; label these Legacy 3-prior rather than matched KiPERT priors.
precision: Exact original scipy sparse float32 pseudobulk means and float32 perturbation-control subtraction, copied to fit-only cache before training. Old-model replay parity threshold remains 2e-6.
isolation: Training workers use Landlock filesystem allowlist excluding test responses, old predictions and test score files.
